Seated on a divan, near a grate in which a cheerful ﬁre was crackling, and with several uniformed officers standing near, was a keen eyed man, wearing lightly a weight of years, and otherwise the conventional red calpac or fez of Turkey, a low white collar, grey cravat, blue serge suit and black shoes of comfortable cut, but no jewellery of any sort.
